semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides gas management systems and analytical instruments critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Prama Instruments Pvt Ltd specializes in manufacturing and providing turnkey solutions for gas management systems and analytical laboratory instruments. Their offerings are crucial for semiconductor fabrication, particularly in creating inert environments through advanced nitrogen gas production systems. With over 35 years of experience, they ensure high-quality standards with ISO 9001:2015 certification.
